questions.q: What are the four Ps of the marketing framework in the summary?
a: Planning, producing, promoting and perfecting
Product, price, place and promotion
Purpose, people, process and performance
Plan, publish, promote and profit
questions.why: Lesson 1 walks through planning, producing, promoting and perfecting content.

questions.q: What should you establish before producing content?
a: Your target audience and what they need
Your total advertising budget
Your competitors' publishing schedule
Your company's mission statement
questions.why: Lesson 1 says market research comes first so you know who you are making content for.

questions.q: How does the summary suggest perfecting your content?
a: Test different approaches and measure the results
Rewrite it until no editor finds a flaw
Wait a year before updating anything
Copy the style of the market leader
questions.why: Lesson 1 recommends trying different materials and using performance metrics to see what works.

questions.q: Why is a clearly defined team structure important in content marketing?
a: Clear roles reduce conflict and strengthen communication
It lets leaders avoid making decisions
It allows the team to skip brainstorming
It guarantees campaigns stay under budget
questions.why: Lesson 2 says clearly laid out roles make disputes less likely and improve internal bonds.

questions.q: Why does personalized content engage customers so well?
a: It speaks to their specific needs and profile
It is cheaper to produce than generic content
It appears at the top of search results
It avoids the need for market research
questions.why: Lesson 3 says targeted content feels like it speaks directly to each customer.
